Review the current architecture without changing files. Map components, data flow, deployment, trust boundaries and failure modes. For EMS, check acquisition, normalization, persistence, forecasting, optimization, validation, actuation and feedback. Identify competing writers, hidden cloud dependencies, stale-data risk and unsafe defaults. Return prioritized findings and ADR candidates.
